name: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer
description: Tabular benchmark used as an easy reference in Line A.

name: Ionosphere
description: Radar returns; used as harder data in Line A.

name: Synthetic (make_classification)
description: scikit-learn make_classification data used in Line A.

name: Blood Transfusion
description: Four native features, used as-is (no reduction). Added in Line A after the baseline results of the other datasets.

name: Synthetic frequency tasks
description: Synthetic tasks whose label depends on frequency k (additive or product of sines), used for the encoding hypothesis (H2) in Line A.

name: TCGA-BRCA (ER status)
description: Estrogen-receptor status (ER+ vs ER−) from primary breast-tumor RNA-seq profiles distributed by the NCI Genomic Data Commons. Open-access, de-identified research records. Not a clinical diagnostic setting.
